items.html: And it is known that no drop descends from above without two drops rising from below to meet it. And it is necessary that from the throat, which is the Malchut of the Hochma mentioned, two drops of MAN should rise, and they should be two times MB. And the matter is that it was explained above that from this throat the two crowns of AVI were made, and it is known that Bina is the name EHEYEH, and since AVI are drawn from this throat, which is the Bina of Arich, there must be two phases there: one on the right side of the throat, from which Aba nurses, and one on the left side of the throat, from which Ima nurses. And since this throat is the phase of Bina, therefore these two phases are all in the phase of EHEYEH as mentioned.
